meta.name: talking-head-recut
meta.description: Package an existing talking-head / interview / podcast video with timed, designed GRAPHIC OVERLAY cards — kinetic titles, lower-thirds, data callouts, quotes, side panels, picture-in-picture — synced to the transcript, on a 16:9 / 9:16 / 4:5 canvas of your choice; the clip plays untouched underneath. Trigger on "graphic overlays", "on-screen graphics", "package / dress up my video". Not plain subtitles (/embedded-captions). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给访谈播客视频配上时间同步的图形卡片，让画面更生动
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你有采访或播客视频,想加标题和重点提示又不重剪
copy.tagline_en: Add timed graphic cards to talking-head videos for a polished, lively look
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have interview or podcast footage and want to add graphics without re-editing

howto.what: 装上后,当你提供一段现成的采访、播客或说话人视频,Claude 会为它配上定时出现的图形卡片(标题、引语、数据标注、下三分之一字幕条、画中画等),并与说话内容同步;视频本身保持不变,最终渲染成带卡片的 MP4。
howto.when: 当你要求“加图形覆盖”“屏幕图形”,或说“包装/装饰我的视频”时触发;纯字幕需求不归它,模糊请求会先转给 /hyperframes。

say.text: 给这段采访视频加上标题和下三分之一的图形卡片
say.note: Claude 会按说话内容设计并渲染成 MP4。

say.text: 把这个播客视频包装一下,按说话内容加数据引语卡片
say.note: 会生成带定时卡片的成品视频。

say.text: 帮我的视频加图形覆盖,画布用竖屏 9:16
say.note: 按你选的画布比例输出。

howto.what_en: Given an existing talking-head / interview / podcast clip, Claude adds timed graphic cards (titles, lower-thirds, data callouts, quotes, side panels, PiP) synced to the speech. The original video plays untouched underneath, and the result is rendered to MP4.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for "graphic overlays", "on-screen graphics", or to "package / dress up my video". Plain subtitles are out of scope; unclear requests are routed to /hyperframes.

say_en.text: Add title and lower-third graphic cards to this interview video.
say_en.note: Claude designs and renders them into MP4.

say_en.text: Dress up this podcast video with data and quote cards synced to speech.
say_en.note: A final video with timed cards is produced.

say_en.text: Add graphic overlays to my video on a 9:16 vertical canvas.
say_en.note: Output follows the canvas you choose.
